The near boot, tucked knee, shoulders and raised hilt form one compact coiled silhouette in the upper-left and center, while the blade drives the opposite diagonal. Loose jacket panels and a short plain cloth belt tail lag upward and backward from the leap; no large cape. Freeze the exact airborne chopping pose with clean limb count and one coherent perspective.
